text: On PropLine: our test of 25,909 PropLine +EV bets found its prop Overs lose money. The screen already re-rates each prop with Vigilant's own cut, so the picks you see are only those Vigilant agrees with. I haven't removed the feature. The sweep still uses requests from the paid key, so I'll check that it's worth its cost, and whether only Unders or other proven bet types should survive, using the settled results in the propline-ev-bets Release. Then I'll cut what loses and tell you what changed.
